title: Conservative Q-Learning for Offline Reinforcement Learning

methods.one_paragraph_description: Actor-critic built on SAC whose Q-function objective is replaced with the CQL(H) regularized objective: it minimizes Q-values under a log-sum-exp over actions (importance-sampled from uniform and current policy) while maximizing Q-values on dataset actions, added to the standard Bellman error; the policy is improved with SAC-style entropy regularization. Alpha is tuned via a Lagrange dual with threshold tau.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: offline RL ('We compare CQL to prior offline RL methods'; 'CQL methods do not use a policy constraint, unlike prior offline RL methods')

base_algorithm.quote: Hyperparameters. For the D4RL tasks, we built CQL on top of the implementation of SAC provided at: https://github.com/vitchyr/rlkit/.

alpha.value: auto-tuned via Lagrangian dual gradient descent (CQL-Lagrange)
alpha.quote: The tradeoff factor, α is automatically tuned via Lagrangian dual gradient descent for continuous control

lagrange_threshold_tau.quote: For our experiments, across D4RL Gym MuJoCo domains, we choose τ = 10.0.

policy_learning_rate.quote: the learning rate for the policy is chosen to be 3e-5 (vs 3e-4 or 1e-4 for the Q-function)

q_learning_rate.quote: 3e − 4 which is the SAC default was chosen to be the default for CQL.

gradient_steps.quote: For our experiments, we used 1M gradient steps for all D4RL domains

num_action_samples_logsumexp.quote: where in practice, we sampled 10 action samples each at every state s from a uniform-at-random Unif(a) and the current policy, π(a|s)

other_hyperparameters.value: SAC defaults incl. twin Q-functions, soft target updates
other_hyperparameters.quote: Other hyperparameters, were kept identical to SAC on the D4RL tasks, including the twin Q-function trick, soft-target updates, etc.
